title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
summary: A burned-out computer hacker, barred from the digital world by a vengeful injury, is recruited by a mysterious employer for one last intrusion job. It leads from grimy Japanese streets to orbital space and deep inside cyberspace.
readIf: you want the original cyberpunk, full of neon, street slang and a cool, jagged mood.
skipIf: you want clear explanations, as the prose is dense, stylised and happy to leave you slightly lost.

pairings.reason: A louder, funnier and more satirical cyberpunk with a similar sense of a corporate-run future.
A newer, more violent noir mystery set in a far-future world of hacked bodies.
An older, moodier story that shaped much of the same dark-city future.
